verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs mention it can auto-create a wallet for users who lack one during the buy flow (email-based), but this is a checkout-flow convenience feature, not a documented API for developers to programmatically provision per-customer or per-purpose wallets/deposit addresses, and there is no documentation of key custody semantics (who holds keys, self-custody vs custodial, recovery). No wallet-creation endpoint, wallet object model, or custody documentation appears anywhere in the evidence pack.
